name: fishball-core
description: Fishball's core plugin, the backend: the Fishball manager session and its preset, its slim app and persona, the private Skills tool, the link, Connect, status, the ask-card store, pairing, the non-UI guard rows and its own plugin settings page. Every other UI change inside Fishball is the fishball-ui plugin's.
//: A DSH bundle of the Fishball plugin set (R-FB-01, design §1.2, §9.1). V3 R-CORE moved the slim child, persona, private Skills tool and child-web pages here unchanged; in a hosted child the instance places this package as a bundle, last (I-PLACE). cordis.patch.yml carries the non-UI guard rows, core's fishball preset and its guard row src/guards/row.js (F-GUARDS), and the slim child rows (I-PLACE); ./client is core's own settings page, with the chunk client.settings.js. Since F-UI (requirements 1.38 Q-N2, R-FB-14) the Fishball page, the Recommended tab, the UI guard rows, the strip and pairing views, the ask cards and the two settings entries are the separate fishball-ui plugin's; core runs normally without it and shows no hint of it (Q-G1). It never depends on dsh-instance (TQ-R3, R-BND-01) or on fishball-ui.
//exports: ./slim/* are the slim child modules core's own patch mounts as fishball-core/<subpath> rows (a path row inside this folder would be a second client source of the package; I-PLACE). ./contracts is K3's runtime constants (with K3a's own copy of the connector's MCP surface, MCP and LINK), for plugins that import them dynamically. There is no ./mcp-schema: F-OWN-SCHEMA removed the vendored copy of the connector's schema (design §1.0b row 1).
//files: contracts/constants.js is K3's one data-only runtime module (K3 amendment 2026-11-14); src/ imports it, so it ships, while the contract's .d.ts files are types only and do not. Core keeps no copy of the connector's files and generates nothing from it (F-OWN-SCHEMA, design §1.0b row 1): its link reads K3a's MCP and LINK in contracts/constants.js, checked against the connector by contract tests.
//dependencies: fishball-shared is the Fishball side's library (R-ARCH-08): core's seam with fishball-ui and the interim modules core shares with the instance; it is bundled, so the tarball carries it. @modelcontextprotocol/client is core's own MCP client for its link (F-LINK; design §5a.1, §6.3, §9.1), never the host's transitive copy: pinned exactly to 2.2.0, the line both hosts ship (0.2.1-rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1, dist byte-identical), as K1 pins the connector's server SDK to the same line.
//peerDependencies: Host packages are resolved from the running DSH installation, as for dsh-instance. dsh-atomic-write (the plugin manager's profile-manifest lock) and dsh-scope (an agent's parent scope) are read by src/guards (F-GUARDS). dsh-connector is a peer for the same reason as the instance's (user decision 2026-11-12): it is not published, so a plain dependency would send an install to a registry; only the V2 child path (src/slim/**, src/persona.js) imports it, its ./contract export; REMOVE-V2 deletes that path and this peer (design §1.0b row 2; the user's decision 2026-11-16). Every other core module reads core's own K3a constants, never this peer (design §1.0b row 1). Its range is the instance's. cosmokit, dsh-app-boot and dsh-llm-pi-ai are the peers of the bundled fishball-shared modules core loads (provider-sync). '*' because engines.dsh is the real compatibility gate.
